verdict.rationale: Factory's docs say that when a Linear or Jira issue is delegated, Droid will "investigate, implement, and test the work." The CLI is described as running in your tests workflow, the platform claims QA on autopilot, and Missions define success criteria before code is written. However, all of this is brief, high-level wording rather than a documented generate-run-validate loop that happens before changes are proposed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic test generation, documented test execution and self-validation (e.g. iterating on failures) before a diff or PR is proposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
